## build.terserOptions

- **Type:** `TerserOptions`

Additional [minify options](https://terser.org/docs/api-reference#minify-options) to pass on to Terser.

In addition, you can also pass a `maxWorkers: number` option to specify the max number of workers to spawn. Defaults to the number of CPUs minus 1.

## css.preprocessorMaxWorkers

- **Type:** `number | true`
- **Default:** `true`

Specifies the maximum number of threads CSS preprocessors can use. `true` means up to the number of CPUs minus 1. When set to `0`, Vite will not create any workers and will run the preprocessors in the main thread.

Depending on the preprocessor options, Vite may run the preprocessors on the main thread even if this option is not set to `0`.

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
